Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 drv_id drives.drive_id%TYPE;
 id_lov lov;
 h_lov_rtn_value boolean;
 nCount number := 0;
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;

 cursor valid_drives (p_sysdate in date)is
 select drive_id
 from drives 
 where ( recruiter_id = nvl(:ctrl_block.recruiter_id, recruiter_id) 
 or recruiter_id in 
 ( select sec_user_id 
 from valid_user_privs 
 where prim_user_id = nvl(:ctrl_block.recruiter_id, recruiter_id) 
 and p_sysdate between eff_date and term_date) )
 and drive_id = :ctrl_block.drive_id;

--a.drive_date, a.drive_id, c.name 
 cursor valid_drives_spon(p_sysdate1 in date) is
 select count(*) 
 from drives a, drive_sponsors b, sponsors c 
 where ( a.recruiter_id = nvl(:ctrl_block.recruiter_id, recruiter_id) 
 or a.recruiter_id in ( 
 select sec_user_id 
 from valid_user_privs 
 where prim_user_id = nvl(:ctrl_block.recruiter_id, recruiter_id) 
 and p_sysdate1 between eff_date and term_date) ) 
 and c.sponsor_id = b.sponsor_id 
 and a.drive_id = b.drive_id 
 and c.name like '%' || :ctrl_block.drive_id || '%' ;

-- and a.drive_date >= ( trunc(sysdate) - to_number( :global.lov_limit ) ) 

begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 if :ctrl_block.sel_list = 'DRIVE' then
 if :ctrl_block.drive_id is null then
 show_error('0080');
-- show_error('11109');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 IF ( :ctrl_block.drive_id IS NOT NULL )
 THEN 
 id_lov := find_lov('drives_lov');
 if id_null(id_lov) then
 show_error('11008');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 open valid_drives(v_local_date);
 fetch valid_drives into drv_id;

 if valid_drives%NOTFOUND then
 close valid_drives;
 open valid_drives_spon(v_local_date);
 fetch valid_drives_spon into nCount;
-- into :ctrl_block.drive_date, :ctrl_block.drive_id,
-- :ctrl_block.sponsor_name;
-- if valid_drives_spon%NOTFOUND then
 if nCount = 0 then
 close valid_drives_spon;
 show_error( '11109' );
 check_package_failure;
 elsif nCount > 1 then
 h_lov_rtn_value := show_lov('drives_lov');
 if h_lov_rtn_value = FALSE
 and :ctrl_block.drive_id is null then
 :ctrl_block.sponsor_name := null;
 end if;
 else
 select a.drive_id, a.drive_date, c.name 
 into :ctrl_block.drive_id, :ctrl_block.drive_date, 
 :ctrl_block.sponsor_name
 from drives a, drive_sponsors b, sponsors c 
 where ( a.recruiter_id = nvl(:ctrl_block.recruiter_id , recruiter_id)
 or a.recruiter_id in ( 
 select sec_user_id 
 from valid_user_privs 
 where prim_user_id = nvl(:ctrl_block.recruiter_id, recruiter_id) 
 and v_local_date between eff_date and term_date) ) 
 and c.sponsor_id = b.sponsor_id 
 and a.drive_id = b.drive_id 
 and c.name like '%' || :ctrl_block.drive_id || '%' ;
 end if;
 if valid_drives_spon%ISOPEN then
 close valid_drives_spon;
 end if;
 elsif valid_drives%ROWCOUNT = 1 then
 select a.drive_date, c.name 
 into :ctrl_block.drive_date, :ctrl_block.sponsor_name
 from drives a, drive_sponsors b, sponsors c 
 where a.recruiter_id = nvl(:ctrl_block.recruiter_id, recruiter_id) 
 and a.drive_id = :ctrl_block.drive_id 
 and c.sponsor_id = b.sponsor_id 
 and a.drive_id = b.drive_id 
 and ROWNUM = 1
 order by a.drive_date desc;
 else
 h_lov_rtn_value := show_lov('drives_lov');

 if h_lov_rtn_value = FALSE
 and :ctrl_block.drive_id is null then
 :ctrl_block.sponsor_name := null;
 end if;
 end if;
 if valid_drives%ISOPEN then
 close valid_drives;
 end if;
 ELSE
 :ctrl_block.drive_date := NULL;
 :ctrl_block.sponsor_name := NULL;
 END IF;
 end if;
end;

/* Modified and verified for Y2k...Sobha....06/99 */
/*
** retrieve details and populate
*/
declare
 v_home_phone varchar2(10);
 v_work_phone varchar2(10);
 sSponsorId drive_sponsors.sponsor_id%TYPE;
 l_intl_Addr varchar2(2000);
 l_intl_addr_flag varchar2(2);

 cursor cur_actiondesc is
 select description
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'ACTCD'
 and code = :drive_checklists.action_code;

 cursor cur_sponame is
 select a.name, b.contact_id, b.sponsor_id
 from sponsors a, drive_sponsors b
 where b.drive_id = :drive_checklists.drive_id
 and a.sponsor_id = b.sponsor_id
 and rownum = 1;

 cursor cur_drvdate is
 select drive_date
 from drives
 where drive_id = :drive_checklists.drive_id;

begin
 /*
 ** load action code description
 */
 begin
 if :drive_checklists.action_code is not null then
 open cur_actiondesc;
 fetch cur_actiondesc
 into :drive_checklists.action_code_description;
 if cur_actiondesc%NOTFOUND then
 close cur_actiondesc;
 end if;
 if cur_actiondesc%isopen then
 close cur_actiondesc;
 end if;
 end if;
 end;

 /*
 ** load sponsor name for the drive
 */
 begin
 if :drive_checklists.drive_id is not null then
 open cur_sponame;
 fetch cur_sponame
 into :drive_checklists.sponsor_name, 
 :drive_checklists.contact_id, sSponsorId;
 if cur_sponame%NOTFOUND then
 close cur_sponame;
 end if;
 if cur_sponame%isopen then
 close cur_sponame;
 end if;
 end if;
 end;

 /*
 ** load drive_date
 */
 begin
 if :drive_checklists.drive_id is not null then
 open cur_drvdate;
 fetch cur_drvdate
 into :drive_checklists.drive_date;
 if cur_drvdate%NOTFOUND then
 close cur_drvdate;
 end if;
 if cur_drvdate%isopen then
 close cur_drvdate;
 end if;
 end if;
 end;

 /*
 ** load Contact details
 */
 begin
 if :drive_checklists.contact_id is not null 
 and sSponsorId is not null then
-- and :drive_checklists.sponsor_id is not null then
-- a.address_1 || ' ' || a.address_2 || ' ' || a.address_3 || ' ' || 

---JAIRAM added international address code in below query

 select sc.last_name || decode( first_name, null, first_name, ', ' || first_name ) name,
 a.h_area_code ||a.h_phone_no home_phone, 
 a.d_area_code ||a.d_phone_no work_phone, 
 a.street_name || ' ' || 
 vcs.city || ' ' || vcs.state || ' ' || vcs.zip address,a.intl_addr_flag, A.INTL_aDDRESS_1||decode(A.INTL_ADDRESS_2,null,null,', '||A.INTL_ADDRESS_2)||decode(A.INTL_aDDRESS_3,null,null,', '||A.INTL_aDDRESS_3)||decode(A.INTL_aDDRESS_4,null,null,', '||A.INTL_aDDRESS_4)||decode(A.COUNTRY_NAME,null,null,', '||A.COUNTRY_NAME)||decode(A.INTL_POSTAL_CODE,null,null,', '||A.INTL_POSTAL_CODE )
 into :drive_checklists.contact_name, 
 v_home_phone,
 v_work_phone,
 :drive_checklists.address,
 l_intl_addr_flag,
 l_intl_addr
 from sponsor_contacts sc, addresses a, valid_city_state vcs
 where sc.sponsor_id = sSponsorId -- :drive_checklists.sponsor_id
 and sc.contact_id = :drive_checklists.contact_id 
 and sc.address_id = a.address_id
 and a.usps_id = vcs.usps_id;
 
 
 if nvl(l_intl_addr_flag,'N') = 'N' then -- by jairam
 :drive_checklists.address := :drive_checklists.address;
 else
 :drive_checklists.address := l_intl_addr;
 end if;

 :drive_checklists.home_phone := substr(v_home_phone, 1,3)||'-'||substr(v_home_phone,4,3)||'-'||substr(v_home_phone, 7,4);
 :drive_checklists.work_phone := substr(v_work_phone, 1,3)||'-'||substr(v_work_phone,4,3)||'-'||substr(v_work_phone, 7,4);

 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when too_many_rows then
 -- message('Too many rows..');pause;
 null;
 when others then
 --message('Others..');pause;
 handle_error;
 end;

PROCEDURE Query_Master_Details(rel_id Relation,detail VARCHAR2) IS
 oldmsg VARCHAR2(2); -- Old Message Level Setting
 reldef VARCHAR2(5); -- Relation Deferred Setting
BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Variable(s)
 --
 reldef := Get_Relation_Property(rel_id, DEFERRED_COORDINATION);
 oldmsg := :System.Message_Level;
 --
 -- If NOT Deferred, Goto detail and execute the query.
 --
 IF reldef = 'FALSE' THEN
 Go_Block(detail);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 :System.Message_Level := '10';
 Execute_Query;
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;

 --

 Set_Block_Property(detail, COORDINATION_STATUS, NON_COORDINATED);

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 RAISE;
END Query_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Trigger_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 
 POST;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
-- Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;
